summary: Updated README.md to reflect all M9 (1.3.0) changes across six areas: (1) Features section — added 4 new bullet points for Embedded Video Player, Cover Images & Thumbnails, Bookmarks, and Bookmarks Browser. (2) ZipArchiveExtractor Security considerations — replaced outdated 'no zip-bomb protection' note with accurate description of 500 MB per-entry and 4 GB total extraction caps with constructor-injectable thresholds. (3) TarXzArchiveExtractor Security guards — updated 'Three' to 'Four' independent guards and added guard 4 describing tar-bomb size limits (same 500 MB/4 GB caps with manual ReadAsync/WriteAsync loop accounting). (4) TarXzArchiveExtractor Cancellation — updated to reflect manual ReadAsync/WriteAsync copy loop replacing the removed ExtractToFileAsync call. (5) TarXzArchiveExtractor documentation — added new Logging subsection documenting ILogger<TarXzArchiveExtractor> constructor injection, LogDebug on start, LogWarning for rejected entries, and LogInformation on completion; replaced outdated 'Open security items' heading (removed resolved A09 logging-gap item) with a focused 'Open security item' section for the remaining A04 silent-overwrite note, updated to reference FileMode.Create rather than the removed ExtractToFileAsync call. (6) Running Tests section — updated ZipArchiveExtractor from 5 to 7 tests (added 2 zip-bomb tests) and TarXzArchiveExtractor/CompositeArchiveExtractor from 9 to 13 tests (added CharacterDevice, Fifo, and 2 tar-bomb tests as separate dedicated fixtures). CHANGELOG.md was already up-to-date (updated by Release Engineer pipeline); no changes required.

comments.note: README.md Logging subsection added to TarXzArchiveExtractor accurately matches the ILogger injection pattern in the source (constructor-injected, NullLogger fallback in parameterless ctor). No drift detected between implementation and documentation.

A09 logging-gap security item removed cleanly — the item was self-referential (deferred injection) and the implementation now fully satisfies the logging spec. A04 (silent overwrite via FileMode.Create) is retained as a forward-note since the risk, while minimal, is architectural and non-trivial to eliminate without adding a duplicate-name guard.
